in_marathi.name: Kanakangi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanakangi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of wealth and prosperity, embodiment of grace and beauty. In Hindu mythology, Kanaka is the golden hue of the sun, and Angi is the goddess of fertility and motherhood.
